# Pinnakle Media

> Pinnakle Media is a video editing, personal branding and social media agency for creators, coaches, podcasters and the companies behind them. Based in Bengaluru, India, working with clients in the US, Canada, the UK, Australia, the UAE and Singapore since December 2022. 100+ clients, 3,000+ videos. Founders: Jayanth M B (Founder & CEO) and Prateek Kumar Tiwari (Co-founder & MD). Legal entity: PKJMB Media Pvt Ltd.

## What we do
- Short-form editing: Shorts, Reels, TikTok. Hook-first cuts, captions, covers. Turnaround 24 hours.
- Long-form YouTube editing with thumbnails, titles and descriptions. Turnaround 48 hours.
- Podcast production: full episodes, clips, promos, audiograms.
- Thumbnails, reel-cover systems, carousels and channel brand kits.
- LinkedIn ghostwriting: 30+ posts a month, daily comments and DMs.
- Channel management: posting to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and Pinterest, with a report every Friday.
- AI production: trained avatars, cloned voice-over, AI documentaries, generated B-roll.
- Growth systems: cold email, Meta ad creative, funnels, websites.
- PinnakleFlow (https://pinnaklemedia.com/flow/): lead follow-up automation. Every DM, comment, call and form fill answered within 60 seconds, booked on the calendar, moved through a pipeline, followed by a review request. Starts at $1 for seven days.
- Pinnakle OS (https://pinnaklemedia.com/os/ and https://pinnaklemedia.app/): the management app we built to run the studio. Boards per client, six statuses (raw received, editing, QC, client review, approved, posted), QC checklists, review links, client portal, posting calendar, Friday report. Open to other agencies.

## How the work runs
15-minute call → onboarding kit (brand kit, access through platform roles, never passwords) → strategy and a 14-day content calendar approved by day five → you record one batch a week → hooks, scripts and titles → edit, design, caption → QC checklist → your review link (revisions in 12 hours) → publish to seven platforms → comments and DMs within the hour → Friday report. Full explanation: https://pinnaklemedia.com/#system

## Results (each one traced to a dashboard, report or payment)
- Sold By Seller: $150K+ revenue, 305 course sales in two weeks from a new Instagram page.
- Crypto Giant: +615% YouTube views in 28 days.
- TruthSeekah: a Short with 1.1M views.
- Dudley: 0 to 12K subscribers and monetised in month five.
- ThriveWell: 15K to 20K subscribers, 111% more than the previous year.
- Yoshi Pradhan: 365K LinkedIn impressions in 28 days.
Case studies: https://pinnaklemedia.com/#cases

## Pricing
No prices are published. Scope is agreed on a 15-minute call (https://tidycal.com/pinnaklemedia/15-minute-meeting) and a one-page scope is sent the same day. Month to month, no lock-in. A free sample edit is available.
